subject: Banking
title: Central Banks and Climate Change
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Central Banks and Climate Change.

hook.text: Should central banks fight climate change? The ECB and Bank of England say yes. The Fed says it's not their job.

buildup.text: The ECB now considers climate risk in its bond purchases. It buys fewer bonds from heavy carbon emitters.

discovery.text: Climate change creates financial risk: stranded assets, extreme weather losses.

twist.text: Critics argue central banks should stick to inflation and employment.

climax.text: As climate risk becomes financial risk, central banks are drawn in.

punchline.text: Climate risk is financial risk. Central banks are getting involved regardless.

quiz.question: How does the ECB address climate change?
options: It considers climate risk in bond purchases
